issues.fix: src/07b_ceiling.js: drive the fittings with the vault's own emission so they follow it in every mood. Inside buildCeilings, after eFn is defined, add `const onVault = (m, d = 0) => Object.assign({}, m, { e: 0.1, eFn: (p) => eFn(p) + d });` and use onVault(CEILMAT.rib, 0.01), onVault(CEILMAT.bezel), onVault(CEILMAT.bezelIn, -0.01) and onVault(CEILMAT.emergBase) in the rib / crest-rib / speaker / emergency-light upper.add calls (lines ~215, 219, 268-270, 273). Keep ribShadow / bezelShadow / emerg unlit, or give them onVault(m, -0.06) so the night shadows are not pure black. The minimal one-liner alternative is CEILMAT.rib e 0.02 -> 0.12, bezel e 0.11, bezelIn e 0.10, emergBase e 0.06 -> 0.12. Target: in q06 / v2 the speaker reads 0.97-1.03x the vault and the rib about 1.03x, with only the 1-px shadow lip darker.
